description: This Java class manages hiding and showing the app from the launcher, including toggling icons, handling notifications, and stopping related services.

classes.name: HidingManager
classes.description: Provides methods to hide and show the app from the launcher, manage notifications, and stop services to conceal app presence.

methods.name: getUnhidePin
methods.description: Retrieves the PIN used to unhide the app from resources.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the app is currently hidden from the launcher.

methods.name: showHideDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to hide the app.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the app from the launcher, shows calculator icon, stops services, and clears notifications.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the app in the launcher, hides calculator icon.

methods.name: removeNotifications
methods.description: Clears all notifications related to the app.

methods.name: stopServices
methods.description: Stops all running services associated with the app to prevent revealing its presence.
